_comment_1: HAND-AUTHORED — Copilot/APM lifecycle hook that runs ESLint on staged JS files.
_comment_2: Hooks here are read by Copilot CLI / APM-aware clients. They are NOT a substitute for git's own pre-commit hooks (which are not version-controllable). For the git-native equivalent, install Husky in app/ and reference this same script.
_comment_3: Schema: `event` names the lifecycle moment; `command` is the shell command to run; `paths` filters which staged files trigger the hook; `failOn` describes how to interpret the exit code. Keep this file <100 lines.
name: pre-commit-eslint
description: Run ESLint on staged JavaScript files in app/ before allowing the commit.
command: cd app && npx eslint --max-warnings=0 $(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- 'app/**/*.js' 'app/**/*.mjs' | sed 's|^app/||')
onFailureMessage: ESLint reported errors or warnings on staged files. Fix them (or run `npx eslint --fix`) and re-stage before committing.
_compatibility_note: If the host client (Copilot CLI, APM) does not support the `pre-commit` hook event, this file is a no-op. The same command can be wired into a Husky pre-commit hook by adding `"prepare": "husky install"` to app/package.json and creating .husky/pre-commit with the same shell command.
